subject: Learning Methods
title: The Habit Loop Explained
description: A quick win: understand The Habit Loop Explained.

hook.text: 40 percent of your daily actions are habits, not conscious decisions. Your brain automates routines to save energy.

buildup.text: Every habit follows a loop: cue, routine, reward. The cue triggers the behavior, the routine is the behavior,.

discovery.text: Understanding the loop gives you power to change it. Keep the cue and reward but swap the routine for a better one.

twist.text: Habits never truly disappear. The neural pathway remains. You can only overwrite them with a stronger competing habit.

climax.text: Identify a study cue (time or place), define the routine (study method), and set a reward (break or treat).

punchline.text: Cue, routine, reward. Design your learning loop.

quiz.question: What are the three components of a habit loop?
